heading: Tuesday Night
text: Clear skies, except for some periods of high clouds in the far south. Patchy valley fog. Patchy frost outside the Champlain Valley, except likely in northern cold hollows. Lows in the 30s, except low to mid 40s near lake Champlain, and some upper 20s in northern cold hollows. Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Areas of valley fog early, then mostly sunny. Highs in the mid to upper 60s. North to northeast winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Mostly clear. Areas of valley fog. Again patchy frost outside the Champlain Valley, except likely in northern cold hollows, with lows from the mid 30s to lower 40s, except mid 40s near lake Champlain, and upper 20s to lower 30s in northern cold hollows. Winds becoming light and variable.
